title: No component anywhere in the frontend builds a link matching this route pattern - it's unreachable via any UI action. It also hard-requires a ?projectId= query param that nothing ever supplies, so even a hand-typed URL shows 'No project specified'.
description: A route that exists in the codebase but has no way to be reached through normal navigation; dead weight / confusing for future maintainers.

component: getScanHistory's includeAnalytics (feeds ScanMonitoringPanel.jsx - currently unmounted/dead per the agent's check)
title: completedScans and averageScore are computed only from the CURRENT PAGE's scans array (post skip/limit), not the full filtered match set, even though totalScans correctly comes from a separate countDocuments(filter) call.
description: A project with 500 scans (300 completed) requesting page 1 (limit 20) would get completedScans/averageScore computed over just those 20 rows instead of the true 300 - currently no visible symptom since the only consumer discards this field, but a landmine for the next consumer.

title: getKey() falls back to finding_info.title (or f.message) when finding_info.uid is absent, then builds a Map keyed by that value - if two different resources in the same scan share an identical generic title with no uid, one silently overwrites the other in the Map, dropping it from the comparison entirely.
description: Conditional on finding_info.uid being missing (not the normal path) - if it happens, N-1 findings sharing a title vanish from a scan comparison instead of appearing as their own resolved/new/unchanged/changed row.

category: Filter accepted by frontend/API but silently not applied server-side

description: No current visible symptom (masked by a client-side redundant filter) but silently broken if that redundant client-side filter is ever removed.
